title: llm-kit project model file, version 1
description: The tracked project model file (default .llm-kit/models.yaml) after YAML parsing. Written in llm-scripting-kit.json-schema-subset/v1. Reader rules this subset cannot state: text values have no leading or trailing whitespace; catalog ids are unique; an efforts list and a traits list have no repeats; a selection names a catalog id; a selection effort is in the row's efforts when the row declares them, and is null when the row declares an empty list; a selection request names a key of requests; a selection with an effort names no request that sets reasoning_budget; each endpoints key is the endpoint of a catalog row; a row's request_defaults does not set a typed setting both as a key and in extras (temperature, top_p); a request profile's extras holds no reserved key (model, messages, stream, api_key, reasoning_effort, reasoning, temperature, top_p, max_tokens, max_completion_tokens, chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort); an endpoint base_url is http:// or https://, a host, then printable ASCII with no space; an endpoint key_env is an environment variable name (an ASCII letter or _, then letters, digits and _); an integer is in -(2**53 - 1) to 2**53 - 1; a value nests at most 100 levels of arrays and objects (the document is level 1); version, max_output_tokens and reasoning_budget are integers, not decimals such as 1.0. Contract and shared cases: docs/reference/llm-kit-formats.md.

extras.description: Wire fields of the endpoint, sent as given.

endpoint.description: How this project's calls reach an endpoint that a catalog row names. effort_style places the effort on the wire and wins over the machine's endpoint registry. base_url and key_env, both or neither, are the endpoint's OpenAI-compatible connection: the base URL and the name of the environment variable that holds its key (null: keyless). The file never holds a key. A machine whose endpoint registry knows the endpoint uses its own connection.

row.description: One catalog row. Omitted efforts: the row does not narrow the effort menu. efforts []: the row has no effort. traits are the consumer's labels for the row; no reader puts them in a request.

request_defaults.description: The lowest layer of every request of this row. The row's own max_output_tokens is its output cap default.

request.description: A named set of request settings that selections point at. It sits above the row's request_defaults and below the call.

selection.description: A selection key's model (a catalog id), effort and request profile. An omitted effort and a null effort mean the same: no effort. An omitted request means no request profile.
